Use case: ui-mockup. A refined, high-fidelity Chinese UI design for the existing 金陵麻将 product, not a generic dashboard. Match the supplied real brand icon and the app's forest green (#174e40), warm ivory (#f5f2e9), restrained matte gold (#d3b36a), charcoal Chinese typography. UI should be crisp, calm, spacious, practical and believable, with excellent readable simplified Chinese text. Avoid bright blue/purple, noisy gradients, fake analytics, irrelevant charts, casino cash, mock devices, hand-drawn text or new branding. The reference logo is a style/brand reference, not an instruction to change its design. This is a design mockup only.
Asset type: a standalone desktop website administration screen for 金陵麻将, landscape 3:2 composition, high resolution. New UI, use input images only as brand reference. Not an in-app administrator panel.
Draw one clean web app screenshot filling the canvas, no browser chrome, no perspective.
Dark green narrow left sidebar with supplied brand icon and exact title "金陵麻将" and small "管理后台". Exactly two navigation rows: selected "公告管理", unselected "版本管理". Small quiet "管理员" at bottom.
The main workspace is warm ivory. Header has "公告管理", secondary explanation "发布后，在牌桌大厅提醒成员", top right quiet "管理员".
Left 58% of workspace: section title "编辑公告" with an ivory-gold outlined "草稿" badge. Label "公告标题", input text "欢迎来到金陵麻将". Label "公告内容", generous textarea with exactly two paragraphs: "文明交流，轻松打牌。" and "如遇问题，可在「我的」中提交反馈。". A subtle information strip reads "对局中不弹出，回到大厅后提醒". Footer actions: secondary outlined "保存草稿", plain "预览", primary dark green "发布公告".
Below the form or in a compact lower section show a small existing announcement list with column labels "公告标题" "状态" "操作"; two short rows "欢迎来到金陵麻将" — "已发布" — "编辑  撤回"; "更新提示说明" — "草稿" — "继续编辑". These rows are demonstration data, visually lower priority than the form.
Right 34% of workspace: a polished panel headed "成员端预览" and tiny badge "横屏". Inside, a miniature landscape preview preserving the input app lobby's garden backdrop, green table, left 南京麻将 title, green right table-list pane, and five bottom tabs "牌桌" "约局" "战绩" "玩法" "我的". Put a centered warm-ivory announcement dialog over a subtly darkened lobby: small "公告", big "欢迎来到金陵麻将", brief body "文明交流，轻松打牌。", dark green button "我知道了", close X. Preview must look like an app, not a phone photograph.
Use a thin gold accent line and subtle shadows, refined rounded corners of 12px, regular alignment, large readable Chinese form text. Exact text above; no extra invented features or permissions menus. Small neutral "设计预览" chip in the web header so this isn't presented as an already live admin system.
